quote:
[p1] When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
[p2] the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，容易在测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1][p2]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 原文指出，过拟合的原因是特征检测器被调整成在训练数据上协同工作良好，但在测试数据上并非如此 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出 dropout：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，以 0.5 的概率随机从网络中省略每个隐藏单元，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“平均网络” [p5]。

quote:
[p6] It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
[p9] Figure 2 shows the frame classification error rate on the core test set of the TIMIT benchmark
[p10] These images were labeled by hand to produce 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images
[p11] ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
[p13] We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6][A1.SS1.p1]、TIMIT 语音识别 [p8][p9]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 训练和测试文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures
claim: 对于语音和两个物体识别数据集，作者使用单独的验证集来选择网络架构，再用选出的架构在真实测试集上评估 dropout [p12]。

quote: This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels
claim: 在 MNIST 上，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个错误降至约 130 个错误，再对随机 20% 像素做 dropout 可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 的识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的记录 [p9]。

quote: Using dropout in the last hidden layer gives an error rate of 15.6%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，dropout 将错误率从 16.6% 降至 15.6% [p10]；

quote: Using 50% dropout in the sixth hidden layer reduces this to a record 42.4%
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，dropout 将错误率从 48.6% 降至 42.4% 的记录 [p11]。

quote: This is reduced to 29.62% by using 50% dropout
claim: 在 Reuters 上，dropout 将测试错误率从 31.05% 降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现精度饱和并迅速退化的退化问题，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起 [S1.p3]。

quote: But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution
claim: 作者指出，按构造深层模型应不差于其浅层对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，而非直接拟合目标映射，原始映射被改写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity
claim: 该形式通过恒等映射的捷径连接实现，捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，整个网络仍可用 SGD 端到端训练 [S1.p6]。

quote: we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical
claim: 当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 Ws 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射已足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估方法，该数据集包含 1000 类，模型在 128 万训练图像上训练，在 5 万验证图像上评估，并在 10 万测试图像上获得最终结果 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes
claim: 作者还使用 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）进行更多研究，重点关注极深网络的行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method
claim: 此外，作者在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测验证 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且在整个训练过程中训练误差都更高，出现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote:
[S4.SS1.p6] the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
[S4.SS1.p7] the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5%
claim: 残差学习逆转了这一情况：34 层 ResNet 优于 18 层 ResNet（提升 2.8%），且 34 层 ResNet 相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
claim: 50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote:
[S4.SS2.p5] our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
[S4.SS2.p6] yet is among the state-of-the-art results (6.43%, Table 6)
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并在深度增加时获得精度提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 误差 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差低于 0.1%，但测试结果差于 110 层网络，作者认为这是由于过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error
claim: 作者在本文中未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并指出结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future
claim: 此外，作者对普通网络优化困难的原因表示将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置分解计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
claim: 注意力机制已成为序列建模和转换模型的重要组成部分，但在大多数情况下仍与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism
claim: 本文旨在提出一种完全依赖注意力机制、摒弃循环的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1] The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.
[S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1] The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 采用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力子层和逐位置全连接前馈网络，并采用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1] We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function
claim: 注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后经 softmax 得到权重，再对 value 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 模型使用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头维度为 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote:
[S3.SS5.p1] we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence
[S3.SS5.p2] In this work, we use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies:
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以利用序列顺序信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 作者在 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）上训练模型 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 训练使用 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
claim: 此外，作者在 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分（约 40K 训练句）以及半监督设置（约 17M 句）上进行了英语成分句法分析实验 [S6.SS3.p2]。

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型超过此前最佳模型（包括集成模型）2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优成绩 [S6.SS1.p1]。

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过所有此前发表的单模型，训练成本不到此前最优模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 模型变体实验表明，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多也会导致质量下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码得到几乎相同的结果 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，Transformer 在仅使用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
claim: 作者指出，将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心的邻域大小 r，可将最大路径长度增至 O(n/r)，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text
claim: 作者还计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大规模输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：预训练语言模型虽在参数中存储事实知识，但难以访问和精确操作知识，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策来源和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 已有结合参数与非参数记忆的模型（如 REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答，本文希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote:
[S2.p1] We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
[S2.SS2.p1] The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR.
[S2.SS3.p1] We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART-large）[S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token. The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based on a different document.
claim: 检索文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化，提出 RAG-Sequence（整个序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）两种形式 [S2.p2]。

quote: We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
claim: 训练时联合微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器，不直接监督应检索哪个文档，并保持文档编码器与索引固定 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: we use the December 2018 dump. Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
claim: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月 Wikipedia dump，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 21M 文档，用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引，训练时检索 top k∈{5,10} 文档 [S3.p1]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.p1] We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
[S3.SS2.p1] we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
[S3.SS3.p1] we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.
[S3.SS4.p1] FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.p1] We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
[S3.SS4.p1] FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 开放域问答报告 Exact Match 分数，Jeopardy 使用 Q-BLEU-1 和人工评估，FEVER 报告标签准确率 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: RAG 在四个开放域问答任务上均取得新的最优结果（TriviaQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上），且无需昂贵的专门预训练 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: RAG can generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not in any retrieved document, achieving 11.8% accuracy in such cases for NQ, where an extractive model would score 0%.
claim: 生成答案即使答案不在任何检索文档中也能正确回答，NQ 上此类情况准确率达 11.8%，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上 RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 BLEU 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 生成上 RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence 和 BART，人工评估显示 RAG 更事实、更具体 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: FEVER 三分类结果与最优流水线模型差距在 4.3% 以内，且无需检索监督 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.
claim: 通过替换索引可更新世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在初步实验中，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”并学会检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: FEVER 的另一个子任务（抽取支持分类预测的维基百科句子）因 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump 而难以直接处理，作者希望未来解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
claim: 此外，作者尝试加入“空文档”机制但未发现性能提升，因此省略 [A6.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。

quote:
[S1.p3] For many of these tasks it is difficult to collect a large supervised training dataset
[S1.p4] the potential to exploit spurious correlations in training data fundamentally grows with the expressiveness of the model
claim: 作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用语言任务难以收集大规模监督数据，且微调在狭窄任务分布上可能利用伪相关、泛化到分布外较差 [S1.p3][S1.p4]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 此外，人类通常只需自然语言指令或极少示例即可学习新语言任务，作者希望 NLP 系统也具备这种灵活性和通用性 [S1.p5]。

quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
claim: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大模型称为 GPT-3，架构与 GPT-2 相同但使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote:
[S2.SS2.p1] we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
[S2.SS2.p2] we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
claim: 训练数据以 Common Crawl 为主，经过质量过滤、模糊去重，并加入 WebText、Books1、Books2 和英文维基百科等高质量语料 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。

quote:
[abstract] GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model
[S2.p2] the model is given a few demonstrations of the task at inference time as conditioning, but no weight updates are allowed
claim: 评估时模型不进行梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务都在零样本、单样本和少样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。

quote:
[S2.p2] We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100 as this is how many examples can fit in the model’s context window
[S2.SS4.p2] which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples
claim: 少样本设置中，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型 2048 token 上下文窗口限制 [S2.p2][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: In Section 3.9, we invent some additional tasks designed especially to probe in-context learning abilities
claim: 评估覆盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI，以及算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成等合成或定性任务 [S3.p3]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置有时可与甚至偶尔超过当时最优的微调模型 [S1.p11]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: 例如在 CoQA 上零样本达到 81.5 F1、单样本 84.0 F1、少样本 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2% [S1.p11]。

quote: GPT-3 can generate synthetic news articles which human evaluators have difficulty distinguishing from human-generated articles
claim: GPT-3 还在单词打乱、算术、使用新词等即时推理任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，并能生成人类难以区分的新闻文章 [S1.p12]。

quote: This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC
claim: 但论文也发现部分任务上少样本表现仍然挣扎，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: it still has notable weaknesses in text synthesis and several NLP tasks
claim: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及在“比较”类任务上单样本甚至少样本仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 结构上，论文只研究自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能损害填空、比较两段内容或需要回读长文的任务表现 [S5.p3]。

quote:
[S5.p4] scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits
[S5.p5] it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
claim: 作者还指出，扩大纯自监督预测可能最终触及预训练目标的极限，且 GPT-3 预训练样本效率仍远低于人类 [S5.p4][S5.p5]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
claim: 此外，少样本学习究竟是在推理时从头学习新任务，还是识别训练中见过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]。

quote:
[S1.p2] In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
[S1.p2] The latter models, while theoretically efficient, have not yet been scaled effectively on modern hardware accelerators due to the use of specialized attention patterns.
[S1.p3] Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，把标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote:
[S1.p1] Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
[S1.p2] In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
[S1.p2] The latter models, while theoretically efficient, have not yet been scaled effectively on modern hardware accelerators due to the use of specialized attention patterns.
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，以及此前将自注意力用于视觉时因专用注意力模式而难以在现代硬件上有效扩展 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.p1] To handle 2D images, we reshape the image into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
[S3.F1] We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的 patch，对每个 patch 做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.F1]。

quote: [S3.SS1.p2] Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 模型沿用 BERT 式的可学习 [class] token 作为图像表示，并在预训练和微调时在其输出上接分类头 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote:
[S3.p1] In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
[S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1] We note that Vision Transformer has much less image-specific inductive bias than CNNs.
[S3.SS2.p1] Note that this resolution adjustment and patch extraction are the only points at which an inductive bias about the 2D structure of the images is manually injected
claim: ViT 刻意保持设计简单，只保留最少的图像特有归纳偏置，二维结构仅在切 patch 和微调时调整位置嵌入等环节被手动注入 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote:
[S4.SS1.p1] we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
[S4.SS1.p1] its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images
[S4.SS1.p2] We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 实验在 ImageNet（1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（14M 图像）和 JFT-300M（303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Pets、Flowers-102 以及 19 项 VTAB 分类套件等基准 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
claim: 模型配置基于 BERT 的 Base/Large 并新增 Huge，用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
claim: 对照基线包括改用 Group Normalization 的 ResNet（BiT）以及将 CNN 特征图送入 Transformer 的混合模型 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote:
[S4.SS3.p2] First, we pre-train ViT models on datasets of increasing size: ImageNet, ImageNet-21k, and JFT-300M.
[S4.SS4.p1] We perform a controlled scaling study of different models by evaluating transfer performance from JFT-300M.
[S4.SS6.p1] We also perform a preliminary exploration on masked patch prediction for self-supervision
claim: 此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控规模研究，以及初步的自监督掩码 patch 预测实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks
claim: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后，较小的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且训练计算资源显著更少；更大的 ViT-H/14 进一步提升性能，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: The BiT CNNs outperform ViT on ImageNet, but with the larger datasets, ViT overtakes.
claim: 在预训练数据规模实验中，ViT 在较小数据集上不如 BiT ResNet，但随着数据增大反超，且更大的 ViT 变体随数据增长才显现优势 [S4.SS3.p2]。

quote: First, Vision Transformers dominate ResNets on the performance/compute trade-off.
claim: 受控规模研究表明，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，约用 2–4 倍更少计算达到相同性能，混合模型在小计算预算下略优但差距随模型增大消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: We find that some heads attend to most of the image already in the lowest layers
claim: 注意力分析显示，部分注意力头在最低层就关注整幅图像，注意力距离随网络深度增加，模型关注与分类语义相关的区域 [S4.SS5.p3]。

quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
claim: 作者指出，ViT 在中等规模数据集（如 ImageNet）上无强正则时精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S4.SS6.p1] but still 4% behind supervised pre-training
[S5.p2] One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
[S5.p2] Another challenge is to continue exploring self-supervised pre-training methods.
[S5.p2] but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training
claim: 自监督预训练虽有提升，但 ViT-B/16 仍比监督预训练低 4%，自监督与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S4.SS6.p1][S5.p2]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 作者还提出将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他视觉任务，以及继续探索自监督预训练，都是尚待解决的挑战 [S5.p2]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：语言模型回答事实性问题时，是基于训练中见过类似问题（数据污染/传统记忆），还是真正从训练语料（如传记）中学习并提取知识 [S1.p5]。

quote: memorizing all sentences in the training data does not ensure that the model can extract or manipulate the factual knowledge from the sentences during inference
claim: 作者指出，仅记忆训练数据中的句子并不保证模型能在推理时提取或操作其中的事实知识 [S1.p3]。

quote: a key question is: How do language models memorize knowledge during training, and extract it later to answer questions or perform logical reasoning during inference?
claim: 因此，核心问题是语言模型在训练中如何记忆知识，并在推理时提取以回答问题 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S2.p2] The synthetic dataset, bioS, generates profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
[S2.p3] We generate a six-sentence biographical text entry for each individual, highlighting six distinct aspects. For diversity, each sentence is randomly chosen from approximately 50 distinct templates.
[S2.p4] We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个体，每人六句传记，每句从约 50 个模板中随机选择）和用 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4]。

quote:
[S2.SS1.p3] Here, we pre-train the language model from scratch on the BIO data... The model is then fine-tuned using half of the QA data and evaluated on the remaining half
[S2.SS1.p4] In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
claim: 采用两种训练方式：预训练+指令微调（先在全部传记上预训练，再用一半个体的 QA 微调，测试另一半）和混合训练（同时用全部传记和一半 QA 训练） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing). Both methods employ simple, nearly-linear probes to extract personal attributes from the model’s hidden states.
claim: 此外，作者提出基于位置的探测（P-probing）和基于查询的探测（Q-probing）两种近乎线性的探测方法，以分析知识在隐藏状态中的编码方式 [S5.p1]。

quote:
[S2.SS1.p1] We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
[A2.p2] Only when presenting our negative result in Figure 2, we also tried a 12-layer, 32-head (each 64-dimensional) GPT2 model (682M).
[A2.p4] we modify our GPT2 architecture to swap its triangular attention matrix for a full matrix, while keeping the GPT2 tokenizer and rotary embedding (removing positional embedding). We label this revised model GBERT.
claim: 实验在 bioS 和 bioR 数据集上进行，使用 GPT2/Llama 架构（bioS 用 124M，bioR 用 302M），并额外测试了 682M 模型和 GBERT 双向模型 [S2.SS1.p1][A2.p2][A2.p4]。

quote: QA accuracy is measured by the proportion of answers that exactly match the correct response.
claim: 评估指标为 QA 生成准确率，即模型生成答案与正确答案完全匹配的比例 [S2.p6]。

quote:
[S2.SS1.p3] The model is then fine-tuned using half of the QA data and evaluated on the remaining half
[S2.SS1.p4] primarily setting ${\mathsf{QA}_{r}}=0.8$ (a $2:8$ BIO to QA entry ratio)
[S2.SS1.p5] In full finetuning a pretrained model is tuned for a downstream task such as QAs. LoRA finetuning improves upon this by freezing all pretrained model parameters and adding low-rank updates
claim: 训练设置包括预训练+QA 微调（全量微调或 LoRA）和混合训练（QA 比例 QA_r=0.8） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4][S2.SS1.p5]。

quote: the OOD generalization accuracies are $86.6\%$ when mixed-trained on bioS single and $77.7\%$ for bioR single.
claim: 混合训练能使模型有效提取知识，在 bioS single 上 OOD 准确率达 86.6%，bioR single 上达 77.7% [S3.p2]。

quote: the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters
claim: 但仅预训练传记再微调 QA 时，模型对未见个体的 QA 准确率为零，即使模型规模远大于个体数、个体被暴露上千次、尝试多种微调参数也无法提取知识 [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: Pretraining on a dataset where each person has 5 diverse biography entries (i.e., different wording, sentence shuffling) boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.
claim: 知识增强（多版本、句子打乱、重复全名）能大幅提升提取能力，例如每人 5 个不同传记条目将准确率从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: The QA finetune accuracy correlates closely with Q-probing accuracy, indicating that the “degree to which the attribute is directly linked to the person’s name” is a crucial factor for effective knowledge extraction.
claim: 探测实验表明，知识增强使属性几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中，Q-probing 准确率与 QA 微调准确率高度相关 [S5.SS2.p4]。

quote:
[S6.p4] Introducing celebrity data boosts the minority group’s QA accuracy (e.g., from 4.4% to 86.8% for the bioS data).
[S6.p5] in the more realistic bioR case, introducing celebrity data increases the minority’s accuracy from 10.0% to 76.3%.
claim: 此外，加入“名人”数据能提升“少数群体”的知识提取准确率（bioS 从 4.4% 到 86.8%，bioR 从 10.0% 到 76.3%） [S6.p4][S6.p5]。

quote: Unless the knowledge is a standalone word or of independent words (like month, day, year), extracting knowledge after MLM pretraining might prove challenging, if not totally impossible.
claim: 双向模型（GBERT）在 MLM 预训练后，除非知识是独立单词，否则难以提取知识 [S7.p8]。

quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.
claim: 论文旨在最高可及能标上观测量子纠缠，此前纠缠在微观到宏观多种系统中已被观测，但在最高能量尺度上仍基本未被探索 [abstract]。

quote:
[S1.p2] Recently, the heaviest fundamental particle known to exist, the top quark, was proposed as a new laboratory to study quantum entanglement and quantum information.
[S1.p3] Among the fundamental fermions of the Standard Model (SM) of particle physics, the top quark is uniquely suited for high-energy spin measurements because of its unique properties
claim: 顶夸克因其极短寿命使自旋信息传递到衰变产物，被提出作为研究量子纠缠与量子信息的新实验室 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: this observation demonstrates the potential of using high-energy colliders, such as the LHC, as tools for testing our fundamental understanding of quantum mechanics
claim: 原文指出，除在新环境中探索量子纠缠的基础意义外，该观测还展示了利用LHC等高能对撞机检验量子力学基本理解的潜力 [S1.p1]。

quote:
[S1.p2] the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement
[S1.p9] It is more convenient to define an entanglement marker by using $D=\textrm{tr}[\mathbf{C}]/3$
[S1.p9] The existence of an entangled state is demonstrated if the measurement satisfies $D<-1/3$, derived from the Peres–Horodecki criterion
claim: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠，通过测量由带电轻子在各自母顶夸克静止系中夹角推断的单一观测量D = −3·⟨cos φ⟩来实现 [S1.p2][S1.p9]。

quote: It is more convenient to define an entanglement marker by using $D=\textrm{tr}[\mathbf{C}]/3$
claim: 纠缠存在的判据是D < −1/3，该判据源自Peres–Horodecki准则 [S1.p9]。

quote: approximately 80% of the production cross-section of $t\bar{t}$ pairs arises from a spin-singlet state, which is maximally entangled
claim: 测量在顶夸克对产生阈值附近的窄区间内进行，因为该区域约80%的产生截面来自最大纠缠的自旋单态 [S1.p8]。

quote: It is reported in a fiducial phase space defined with stable particles to minimize the uncertainties that stem from limitations of the Monte Carlo event generators and the parton shower model
claim: 结果在由稳定粒子定义的基准相空间（fiducial phase space）中报告，以最小化蒙特卡洛事件产生器和部分子簇射模型在建模顶夸克对产生时的局限所导致的不确定性 [abstract]。

quote: The complete data set of $pp$ collision events at a center-of-mass energy of $\sqrt{s}=$13\text{\,}\mathrm{TeV}$$ collected with the ATLAS experiment during 2015–2018 is used, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1.
claim: 分析使用ATLAS探测器在2015–2018年采集的质心能量13 TeV、积分亮度140 fb⁻¹的完整质子-质子碰撞数据集，聚焦于单电子或单缪子触发记录的数据 [S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: To be selected, events must have exactly one electron and one muon with opposite-sign electric charges.
claim: 事件选择要求恰好一个电子和一个缪子且电荷相反，至少两个喷注且至少一个被标记为源自b强子 [S1.SS2.p1]。

quote: The optimal mass window for the signal region was determined to be $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV.
claim: 信号区定义为340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV，另设380 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 500 GeV和m_{t\bar{t}} > 500 GeV两个验证区，各区域顶夸克对纯度均超过90% [S1.SS2.p4]。

quote: The observed distribution is corrected for these effects with a simple method: a simulation-based calibration curve which connects any value at the detector level to the corresponding particle-level value.
claim: 数据通过基于模拟的校准曲线从探测器水平修正到粒子水平 [S1.SS2.p6]。

quote: The observed (expected) results are: $D=-0.537\penalty\ \pm 0.002\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.019\penalty\ \text{[syst.]}\penalty\ (-0.470\pm 0.002\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.017\penalty\ \text{[syst.])\penalty\,$ in the signal region of $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV
In the signal region, the observed and expected significances with respect to the entanglement limit are well beyond five standard deviations
claim: 观测结果与无纠缠假设偏离超过五个标准差，确立了纠缠顶夸克对态的形成，构成首次在夸克-反夸克对中观测到纠缠 [S1.SS4.p4]。

quote: In both of the validation regions, with no entanglement signal, the measurements are found to agree with the predictions from different MC setups within the uncertainties.
claim: 在两个验证区，测量结果与不同蒙特卡洛设置的预言在不确定度内一致，作为对测量方法的一致性检验 [S1.SS4.p1]。

quote: a demonstration of spin entanglement in $t\bar{t}$ pairs is challenging due to the inability to control the internal degrees of freedom in the initial state

claim: 论文要解决的核心问题是：现有抗体逆折叠工具在 CDR 区域的序列恢复率有限，且基于 ProteinMPNN 的工具存在链重排、CDRH3 第 112 位插入或引入 gap 等与抗体结构不兼容的问题 [S1.p5]。

quote: Protein inverse folding models are trained to predict sequence given structure, and can therefore be used to design novel sequences without altering the antibody backbone structure.
claim: 其动机在于，抗体优化需要选择能维持结构和结构介导性质（如稳定性与抗原结合模式）的突变，而逆折叠模型可在不改变抗体骨架结构的前提下设计新序列 [S1.p3]。

quote: AntiFold leverages ESM-IF1’s pre-training on $>$ 12M structures by fine-tuning the model further on solved and predicted antibody structures.
claim: AntiFold 由 ESM-IF1 逆折叠架构微调而来，利用其在超过 1200 万个结构上的预训练，再在抗体结构上继续训练 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: CDRH3 AAR was improved through use of a span-masking scheme (36.4%), additional masking of random residues (53.2%), weighting masking towards CDR residues with a 3:1 weight (53.3%), layer-wise learning-rate decay (54.4%) and including predicted structures from OAS (58.4%)
claim: 微调中采用了 span masking、随机残基额外掩码、以 3:1 权重偏向 CDR 残基的掩码、逐层学习率衰减，以及纳入 OAS 预测结构等策略 [S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: we concatenated the backbone coordinates of the light chain to the end of the heavy chain, with a 10 position padding of “gap” tokens
claim: 模型将轻链骨架坐标拼接在重链之后，中间以 10 个 gap token 填充，以表示重轻链复合物 [S0.SS1.SSS3.p4]。

quote: we trained, validated and tested our model on the same data: 2,074 solved complexes from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab), and 147,458 structures of sequences from the Observed Antibody Space (OAS) paired database modeled with ABodyBuilder2.

quote:
[S3.SS2.p1] We identified 56 antibody structures in the test set that were solved using X-ray crystallography with a resolution below 2.5 Å.
[S3.SS2.p2] we modeled these sequences using ABodyBuilder2, aligned them with the FR backbone of their experimentally solved counterpart, then calculated the root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) over the CDR residues
claim: 序列设计评估在测试集中 56 个分辨率低于 2.5 Å 的 X 射线晶体结构上进行，每个抗体采样 20 条序列并用 ABodyBuilder2 建模后计算 CDR 骨架 RMSD [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。

quote:
[S3.SS3.p1] We calculated the log-likelihoods of the 2209 variable domain variants of Fab D44.1 (PDB 1MLC)
[S3.SS3.p3] we applied the model to 124 variants across 7 antibodies generated in protein language model-guided affinity maturation experiments.
claim: 结合亲和力预测在抗溶菌酶抗体 Fab D44.1（PDB 1MLC）的 2209 个变体深度突变扫描上评估，并在 7 个抗体的 124 个蛋白语言模型引导亲和力成熟变体上进一步测试 [S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS3.p3]。

quote: AntiFold demonstrated a substantial improvement in AAR on the experimental structure test set as compared to the original ESM-IF1 model (60 vs 43% AAR for CDRH3, p $<$ 0.005
claim: AntiFold 在实验结构测试集上的 CDRH3 氨基酸恢复率显著优于原始 ESM-IF1（60% vs 43%），也优于 AbMPNN 的 CDRH3（60% vs 56%）、其余 CDR 区域（75-84% vs 63-76%）和多数 FR 区域（87-94% vs 85-89%）[S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: AntiFold generated sequences with high structural similarity to the original backbone, with a mean CDR region RMSD of 0.95, versus AbMPNN 0.98, ESM-IF1 1.01, ProteinMPNN 1.03 and native RMSD of 0.63.
claim: 其设计序列重新折叠后与原始骨架高度相似，CDR 区域平均 RMSD 为 0.95，优于 AbMPNN 的 0.98、ESM-IF1 的 1.01 和 ProteinMPNN 的 1.03 [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: AntiFold significantly outperformed the other models with a Spearman’s rank correlation of 0.418, versus ESM-IF1 (0.334), AbMPNN (0.322), ProteinMPNN (0.301) and ESM-2 (0.264)
claim: 在零样本结合亲和力预测中，AntiFold 的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.418，显著优于 ESM-IF1、AbMPNN、ProteinMPNN 和 ESM-2 [S3.SS3.p1]；

quote: With this additional context, AntiFold’s performance improves in the case of all CDR regions, in particular the CDR2 ( $S_{r}$ 42.7 to 47.3%, p $<$ 0.005) and CDR3 ( $S_{r}$ 29.8 to 32.0%, p $<$ 0.005), but not for framework residues.
claim: 加入抗原链后，CDR2 和 CDR3 区域的预测性能进一步提升 [S3.SS3.p2]。

quote: AntiFold achieved significantly improved separation of these groups, scoring the improved variants with a median rank score of 80% (p $<$ 0.005) versus 73 % for ProteinMPNN, 57 % for ESM-IF1 and 55 % for AbMPNN.

quote: AntiFold’s recovery performance is lower for antibodies with longer CDRH3 loops (Figure S7), with a median AAR of 71% for shorter loops (6-9 residues) and 48% for longer loops (16-28 residues).
claim: AntiFold 对较长 CDRH3 环的恢复性能较低，短环（6-9 个残基）中位 AAR 为 71%，长环（16-28 个残基）为 48% [S0.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

claim: 逐层学习率衰减未进一步提升序列恢复率，但作者为降低过拟合风险并保持对未测试性质的泛化能力而保留了该策略 [S0.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

quote: We did not directly compare against IgMPNN as the model weights and training data were not available.
claim: 此外，由于 IgMPNN 的模型权重和训练数据不可获得，论文未与其直接比较 [S2.SS1.p1]。

claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何准确且高效地预测任意材料在实际合成与工作条件（有限温度和压力）下的性质 [S1.p1]。

quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习方法探索广阔材料空间，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor
claim: 第一性原理监督器在 GGA-PBE（对部分材料加 Hubbard U）水平上提供能量、力和应力信号，训练后的模型作为代理引导探索器采集更多结构，形成主动学习循环 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: In this work, we opt to use two primary architectures, M3GNet and Graphormer as the backbones for MatterSim.
claim: 模型架构主要采用 M3GNet 和 Graphormer 两种骨干网络，前者数据效率高、推理快，后者基于 Transformer、可扩展性强但推理更慢、显存需求更高 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: As of the date of publication, the training dataset contains $\sim$ 17M structures labeled with first-principles computations.
claim: 训练数据集包含约 1700 万个第一性原理标注结构，覆盖 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa 的温度压力范围 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote:
[S6.p1] MPtrj-1k and Alexandria-1k are collected by sampling randomly one thousand materials from the MPtrj and Alexandria dataset, respectively.

[S2.SS2.p2] MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
[S2.SS2.p3] Fig. 4 (a) shows the benchmark results on the materials from the PhononDB, using maximum phonon frequency as an indicator, and a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$.

claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB 声子数据库、力学性质、自由能与相图、以及 118 个系统的分子动力学模拟等任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36 meV/atom (43 meV/atom as chemical accuracy) on MPF-TP
claim: MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的平均绝对误差，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3]。

quote: MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
claim: 在 MatBench Discovery 上取得 F1 分数 0.83 和 25 meV/atom 的形成能平均绝对误差 [S2.SS2.p2]。

quote:
[S2.SS2.p3] a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$

claim: 声子最大频率预测 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: MatterSim achieves a sub- $10\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ error for temperatures up to $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ when compared with QHA computations at PBE level of theory
claim: 与 PBE 计算相比，1000 K 以内 Gibbs 自由能误差低于 10 meV/atom；与 200 多个材料的实验测量相比，MAE 为 15 meV/atom [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: MatterSim achieved more than 90% success rate for all the material families tested, exhibiting robustness over wide temperature ranges.
claim: 在 118 个系统的分子动力学模拟中，所有材料类别的成功率超过 90% [S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前采用半局域原子相互作用描述，在长程相互作用主导的场景（如聚合物和多相体系）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 数据覆盖方面，模型仅在均匀体相体系上训练，未显式包含对催化等应用至关重要的表面和界面数据 [S3.p3]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 此外，模型目前仅原生支持 DFT-PBE 水平的推理，限制了其在涉及复杂相互作用（如聚合物和有机液体）体系中的应用 [S3.p3]。

quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
claim: 模型目前仅支持能量、力和应力的原生预测，纳入电荷、自旋、磁矩等更多数据模态可能进一步提升精度和适用性 [S3.p3]。

quote:
[S1.p2] This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
[S1.p3] What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
claim: 论文要探讨的问题是：不同神经网络模型对数据的表征是否正在趋同，这种趋同是否会持续，以及最终会收敛到什么 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe
claim: 作者提出的核心假说是，这种趋同存在一个终点和驱动原则：不同模型都在试图得到对现实的表征，即生成观测数据的现实世界事件的联合分布 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S1.p5] We call this converged hypothetical representation the “platonic representation” in reference to Plato’s Allegory of the Cave
[S1.p6] The platonic representation hypothesis refers to the situation where we are in an Anna Karenina scenario and the “happy representation” that is converged upon is one that reflects a statistical model of the underlying reality.
claim: 作者将这一趋同的表征称为“柏拉图式表征”，并指出其与科学哲学中的“收敛实在论”以及“安娜·卡列尼娜情景”相关 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings. We characterize such a representation by the similarity structure it induces, referred to as its kernel.
claim: 论文将表征定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（相似度结构）来刻画，将表征对齐定义为两个核之间相似度的度量 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels
claim: 实验中使用互最近邻度量，即两个核诱导的k近邻集合的平均交集除以k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。

quote: To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
claim: 对于跨模态对齐，作者使用成对数据集（如图像-标题数据）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核和文本核并测量其对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.p2] The Multitask Scaling Hypothesis There are fewer representations that are competent for $N$ tasks than there are for $M<N$ tasks.
[S3.SS2.p2] The Capacity Hypothesis Bigger models are more likely to converge to a shared representation than smaller models.
[S3.SS3.p2] The Simplicity Bias Hypothesis Deep networks are biased toward finding simple fits to the data, and the bigger the model, the stronger the bias.
[S4.SS2.p4] Therefore, the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).
claim: 此外，作者提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种假说来解释趋同 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并在理想化世界模型下形式化地论证对比学习收敛到PMI核 [S4.SS2.p4]。

quote: We consider 78 vision models in total:
claim: 在视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了78个视觉模型，包括不同规模的ViT、ResNet-50和ResNet-18，训练目标涵盖分类、MAE、DINO、CLIP和对比学习等 [A3.SS1.p1]。

quote:
[A3.SS1.p2] To test representation quality, we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
[A3.SS1.p3] we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset
claim: 这些模型在VTAB的19个分类任务上做线性探测，并在Places-365验证集上以k=10、1000个图像表征计算对齐 [A3.SS1.p2][A3.SS1.p3]。

quote:
[A3.SS2.p1] The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
[A3.SS2.p2] For vision models, we consider ViT models of various sizes trained on various data and objectives.
[A3.SS2.p3] we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT (Wikipedia-based Image Text;)
claim: 在跨模态对齐方面，作者比较了BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA等语言模型与多种ViT视觉模型，使用WIT数据集的1024个样本、k=10计算对齐 [A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p2][A3.SS2.p3]。

quote:
[S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1] We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
[A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1] We collect color cooccurrence statistics from the CIFAR-10 dataset
[S6.F9] We vary caption length using the Densely-Captioned-Images (DCI) dataset.
[A5.p4] we find that the alignment score also improves as caption length increases
claim: 作者还进行了颜色共现案例研究，从CIFAR-10图像共现和语言共现中学习颜色表征并与CIELAB感知空间比较 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]，以及用DCI数据集改变标题密度来测试信息量对对齐的影响 [S6.F9][A5.p4]。

[S2.F3] The results show a linear relationship between language-vision alignment and language modeling score

quote: learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation
claim: 颜色案例研究表明，从图像共现或语言共现中学习都能恢复大致相同的感知颜色表征 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote:
[S6.F9] With denser captions, the mapping may become more bijective, leading to improved language-vision alignment scores.

[S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1] Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.

[S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1] Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.

quote: there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment
claim: 此外，对齐度量本身存在争议，作者只重点使用互最近邻一种度量 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]；

quote:

MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset. 4. CodeContests: A dataset of competitive programming problems. Each problem has a text description, along with a set of input-output test cases (hidden from the model) that can be used to verify the correctness of a candidate solution. quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24).
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最高 27%，并通过 budget forcing 将 AIME24 成绩从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。

quote: we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.
claim: budget forcing 提供完美控制、良好扩展斜率，并取得最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融表明，联合使用质量、难度、多样性三个标准至关重要，随机选择、仅选最长或仅选最多样均导致显著更差性能（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全量 59K 样本相比 1K 选择没有实质提升 [S1.p3]。

quote: We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
claim: s1-32B 是最样本高效的开放数据推理模型 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Surprisingly, we find that simply sampling until the generation fits a specific length leads to an inverse scaling trend as depicted in Figure 6.
claim: 拒绝采样出现逆扩展趋势，作者假设较短生成往往是模型一开始就走上正确路径的，而较长生成往往是模型犯错并回溯的 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 作者指出，传统范式基于两个假设——掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，以及监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
claim: 作者认为这种数据密集型范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型已在预训练中编码大量数学知识，挑战从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

quote:
[abstract] In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning can emerge through minimal but strategically designed demonstrations of cognitive processes.
[S3.p1] In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
claim: 论文提出 LIMO 假说，认为在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范涌现，其激发阈值取决于模型预训练知识库的完整性和后训练样本作为“认知模板”的有效性 [abstract][S3.p1]。

quote: first conducting coarse difficulty filtering to eliminate trivial problems, then fine-grained difficulty assessment to identify challenging questions, followed by knowledge point diversification to ensure comprehensive coverage.
claim: 方法上，作者构建了一个多层筛选的数据 curation 流程：先进行粗粒度难度过滤，再进行细粒度难度评估，并进行知识点多样化，同时根据逻辑连贯性、步骤清晰度和解答准确性筛选推理链，最终得到 800 条训练样本 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S1.p4] first conducting coarse difficulty filtering to eliminate trivial problems, then fine-grained difficulty assessment to identify challenging questions, followed by knowledge point diversification to ensure comprehensive coverage.
[S1.p4] This meticulous process yields a compact yet potent dataset of just 800 training samples.
[S1.p4] With simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) using only this curated dataset based on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct

claim: 随后使用简单监督微调在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上训练 [S1.p4][S4.p2]。

quote: Our primary evaluation suite includes several well-established mathematical competitions and benchmarks: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 域内评估包括 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: First, we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 分布外评估包括 OlympiadBench、中文多语言基准 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估使用 pass@1 指标，在零样本思维链设置下进行；较大基准使用贪心解码单样本，较小基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote:
[S6.SS1.p1] These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview, a model specifically designed for mathematical problem-solving with strong reasoning capabilities; and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, which serves as our base model for comparative analysis.
[S6.SS1.p2] These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples covering mathematics, science, coding, and puzzles, with solutions following a structured reasoning format generated by DeepSeek-R1; and NuminaMath-100k, a randomly selected 100k subset of NuminaMath-CoT
claim: 基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及使用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: On in-domain tasks, LIMO achieves the best results across all benchmarks.
claim: LIMO 在域内任务上取得最佳结果：AIME24 准确率 63.3%，MATH500 准确率 95.6%，AMC23 准确率 96.3%，均超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 和 OpenAI-o1-preview [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上平均性能最高，达 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

claim: 论文指出当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。
